[NADP.7.1] The taxonomy is [NERR], with the impl-side detail at
[IERR.2]; the specific codes the adapter cb is expected
to return:

| Code | Cause |
|---|---|
| `DS_OK` | request accepted: the result is kept to assert after the pump returns, or async work is queued ([NADP.4.2.2]) |
| `DS_ERR_NOT_FOUND` | service name doesn't match anything this adapter handles |
| `DS_ERR_INVAL` | call body is malformed for this service |
| `DS_ERR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE` | source system unreachable; the adapter may instead assert a `CallError` with an `adapter.*` code ([LECC.4.3]) |
